name: oak lane
description: a narrow pedestrian alley that cuts between the buildings, saving locals a minute and a half on their walk. the walls are brick and windowless, streaked with decades of rain. a string of bare bulbs hangs crooked over the middle, half of them burned out. the ground is stained concrete with a few slick drain covers. the air is stiller and colder here, carrying a faint whiff of cooking oil from the diner's back vent.
